title: Baseline manifest of 2027 plan documents used in the SHIBA sheet verification
project_root: dad-project/ (paths below are relative to it)

fingerprint_method.text_seq_sha256: SHA-256 of concat over pages of re.sub('[^a-z0-9$%]', '', NFKC(page_text).lower()); order-sensitive
fingerprint_method.page_text_sha256_16: first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 of the same normalization, per page, in page order (index 0 = PDF page 1)
fingerprint_method.word_bag_sha256: SHA-256 of sorted lines 'token count' over re.findall('[a-z]+|\d+', NFKC(all_text).lower()), all_text = pages joined with newline; order-insensitive
fingerprint_method.numbers_sha256: SHA-256 of sorted lines 'token count' over re.findall('\$?\d+(?:[.,]\d+)*%?', same text) with commas removed

url_check_results.text_identical: different bytes (e.g. re-saved by a browser), same extracted text in the same order
url_check_results.numbers_identical_wording_differs: every number and $/% amount matches; some words differ
url_check_results.same_except_pages_without_text: every page's text matches except pages that have no extractable text in one copy (listed in pages_differing_text)
url_check_results.differs: numbers differ somewhere; see pages_differing_text and note
